title: AutoInstaller
description: This mod auto installs mods when connecting to servers
body:
AutoInstaller
Automatically prompt players to install server-required mods when joining.
How It Works
When a player connects to a server running AutoInstaller, they'll see a mod selection screen showing all mods the server requires or recommends. Players can:
- Install Mods - Download and install selected mods directly
- Play - Join the server without installing (if no required mods are missing)
- Cancel - Return to the server list
Features
- Required & Recommended Mods - Server admins can mark mods as required (must install) or recommended (optional)
- Smart Detection - Automatically detects which mods the player already has installed
- Dependency Resolution - Automatically fetches mod dependencies from Modrinth
- No Restart Needed to Join - Click Play to join immediately after viewing the mod list
- Clean UI - Simple, intuitive mod selection screen
For Server Admins

Configure your mod list in config/autoinstaller/mods.json:
```json
{
  mods: [
    {
      id: voicechat,
      name: Simple Voice Chat,
      category: REQUIRED,
      url: https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9eGKb6K1/versions/xxx/voicechat-xxx.jar
    },
    {
      id: xaeros-minimap,
      name: Xaero's Minimap,
      category: RECOMMENDED,
      url: https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/1bokaNcj/versions/xxx/Xaeros_Minimap_xxx.jar
    }
  ]
}
```
Categories:
- REQUIRED - Player must install to join (Play button disabled until installed)
- RECOMMENDED - Suggested but optional
- OPTIONAL - Available for download but not selected by default
Installation
1. Install on both server and client
2. Requires Fabric API (https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
3. Configure your mod list on the server
4. Players will see the mod prompt when connecting
Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.10
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
